name: Unnerving Gaze
body:
School illusion (phantasm)) [emotion, fear, mind-affecting]; Level antipaladin 1, inquisitor 0, lathspell 0, legendary ninja 1, mesmerist 0, psychic 0, sorcerer/wizard 0, spiritualist 0, witch 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one living creature
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You complete the spell, and your face shifts into the form of the target’s bitter enemy or departed loved one.

The target takes a -1 penalty on attack rolls and a -1 penalty on saving throws against fear effects. The target only takes the penalty while they can see you.
